sources.title: GLM-5V-Turbo - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT
sources.snippet: GLM-5V-Turbo is Z.AI's first multimodal coding foundation model, built for vision-based coding tasks. It can natively process multimodal inputs such as images, video, and text, while also excelling at long-horizon planning, complex coding, and action execution.
